n: IFP110 is an 110-inch, 4K UHD interactive display with an IR (ViewBoard IFP110)
d: ViewSonic IFP110 is an 110-inch, 4K UHD interactive display with an IR recognition touchscreen that supports 40 touch points on Windows and 20 on Android All-in-one video device for Zoom/Teams/BYOD. Designed for medium to large rooms up to 30 people Mounting hardware included. speakers integrated with clear and high quality sound Included all the support needed to install the screens on the wall
